Author config changes (GitOps-preserving)

        
Edit the controller config here to change alert patterns (rules), pattern grouping, routing, and channels. This does not apply changes — Git stays the source of truth. Validate, review the diff, then export the YAML and commit it to your ConfigMap / Helm values. (Channel credentials are managed separately — Phase 2.)

        

          
          
          
          
          
          
        

        
      


      

        
Build from forms (no YAML by hand)

        
Fill the forms, Render to YAML, then Validate / Diff / Export above. Forms cover alert patterns (rules), pattern grouping, and routing/channels; every other config field is preserved.

Notification channels

        
Configured sinks. Test sends one synthetic alert through the sink using its existing credentials — no secrets are read or stored by the console.

        
⚠ Test-fire sends a real notification. For PagerDuty / Opsgenie this may open an incident or page on-call. Requires a write token.

        
Testing is disabled (no write token set, or the server has no ALERTKUBE_API_WRITE_TOKEN).

No channels registered.

        
To add a channel or rotate credentials, set the sink secret (Helm) and update routing via the Author tab, then commit.

      


      

        
Test a channel by Secret reference (opt-in)

        
Validate a channel whose credential lives in a Kubernetes Secret before you wire it. The controller reads the referenced key at send-time only and never stores or returns it. Requires api.allowSecretRead=true (grants the controller secrets:get in its namespace) and a write token.

        

          
          
          
          
          
        

      

    


    
    

      

        
Create a runtime silence

        
Time-boxed mute applied immediately — survives leader failover but lives outside Git. Use for transient noise; durable changes belong in config. Requires a write token.

        
Runtime writes are disabled (no write token set, or the server has no ALERTKUBE_API_WRITE_TOKEN). You can view silences but not create them.
